posts.author: Ardonie
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
I'm looking for a plugin for RPG Maker MZ that would help me to make a customizable character system.
It's for a commercial project using custom sprites and UI.
Here's the features I'm looking for :
- Layering sprites on the hero character and be able to change it through conditions, script calls and/or plugin commands, using variables or the weapons and outfit sections of the database.
- [In best cases] Layering sprites of the on map events through conditions, script calls and/or plugin commands, using variables.
- [In best cases] Layering sprites of the following party members using the methods mentioned above.
Here's what won't help me out:
- a plugin based on the built-in RTP character creator
Thank you for reading and hopefully, we can find a solution!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Ardonie said:
Here's what won't help me out:
- a plugin based on the built-in RTP character creator
Click to expand...
I think you misunderstood how those plugins work, because that should not be a limitation for your case.
Nothing can access the character generator itself.
What those plugins do is using a copy of the generator pictures to do their own with them.
But because of that those plugins can use any pictures as long as the pictures follow the naming convention of the generator - and you'll have to use some form of naming convention anyway, or whatever plugin you use won't know where or how your pictures should be used.
